name: Kimihane: Kanojo to Kanojo no Koi Suru Ikkagetsu
original_name: きみはね 彼女と彼女の恋する１ヶ月
source:
Hina, Rin and Fumi are new roommates at Seiba Girls’ School. Even though they had different personalities and upbringings, they had one thing in common: they recall seeing an angel when they were small. They each suspected that one of the other girls was actually an angel.

[Edited From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/01/09/january-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
阳菜、伦与文是圣Seiba女子学校的新室友。她们性格与成长背景各不相同，却有一件共同经历：小时候都记得见过天使。她们分别怀疑，三人中有一人其实是天使。

[改编自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/01/09/january-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
